_about: Advisories the CI dependency audit (npm run deps:check) allows for a dated window. Each one names one advisory and the package npm reports it on, cites an owner decision recorded under docs/decisions/, and expires at most 92 days after it was decided. It also stops applying as soon as npm reports a fix that needs no major upgrade. Rules: scripts/lib/auditGate.mjs. Remove an entry by hand once npm no longer reports its advisory; the check prints a warning when that happens. Empty since 2026-10-24 (D156): the braces entry (D53, D111) went when GitHub withdrew its advisory.
